title: Seediq people - Wikipedia
text: The Seediq (sometimes Sediq, Seejiq, pronounced [seˈʔediq], [səˈdiq], or [səˈʔəɟiq]; Chinese: 賽德克族; pinyin: Sàidékèzú) are a Taiwanese indigenous people who live primarily in Nantou County and Hualien County. Their language is also known as Seediq.
